pedestrian_routes_and_bridges.name: John Seigenthaler Pedestrian Bridge Walk
pedestrian_routes_and_bridges.description: Scenic pedestrian-only link crossing the Cumberland River, connecting the East Bank (near Nissan Stadium) to Downtown Nashville (near 3rd Avenue). Highly popular for low-cost stadium parking walkovers and skyline views.

features: ADA-compliant elevator on 2nd Avenue S for bridge deck access

pedestrian_routes_and_bridges.name: Cumberland River Greenway Walkway
pedestrian_routes_and_bridges.description: Reconnects the greenway over the Ascend Amphitheater grounds, allowing for pedestrian and bicycle flow. Access may be restricted to ticket holders during events.

pickup_and_dropoff_zones.description: Designated drop-off and pickup zone for rideshare (Uber/Lyft) and taxis.

alternative_parking_garages.name: Symphony Place Garage
alternative_parking_garages.notes: Very close to the venue, reservation recommended via parking apps.

alternative_parking_garages.name: Omni Nashville Garage
alternative_parking_garages.address: 250 Rep. John Lewis Way S, Nashville, TN 37203

alternative_parking_garages.name: Music City Center Garage
alternative_parking_garages.address: 201 Rep. John Lewis Way S, Nashville, TN 37203
alternative_parking_garages.notes: Large municipal garage with competitive event parking rates.

alternative_parking_garages.name: Nissan Stadium Lots (East Bank)
alternative_parking_garages.notes: Park at Nissan Stadium lots (when available, often $10 or free during non-stadium events) and walk across the John Seigenthaler Pedestrian Bridge.

accessible_dropoff.location: Corner of Molloy Street and 1st Avenue South
accessible_dropoff.notes: Designated ADA drop-off point near the venue entrance.

facilities.restrooms: All venue restrooms are ADA accessible. A single-user accessible restroom is located next to Gate 4 in Building C.
facilities.concessions_and_merchandise: All concession and merchandise stands are fully accessible.
facilities.seating: ADA-accessible seating is available in the pavilion, ADA Lawn, and ADA Box areas. Reservation in advance is highly recommended.

wego_star_commuter_rail.notes: Commuter train service operating primarily during weekday commute hours. Walk directly south along 1st Ave S to reach the venue.

wego_bus_routes.notes: Direct bus routes serving downtown Nashville. Use the WeGo Trip Planner or real-time transit apps to verify scheduling on event nights.
